freedom, meet
imagination
Jeep Renegade® lets you see
®
the world your way. Go from urban
adventures to off-road discoveries with the
unique comforts and powerful capabilities
found in Jeep Renegade®. With a face
®
that’s a recognized member of a legendary
family, Renegade arrives with authentic
Jeep Brand DNA engineered throughout.
New standard safety and security systems
are included in every trim level, including
Blind Spot Monitoring11 and Rear Cross-Path
Detection9 Systems, and LaneSense® Lane
Departure Warning with Lane Keep Assist1.0
Two available 4x4 systems offer dependable
all-weather fortitude to keep you moving in
challenging conditions, while the rear-axle
disconnect works intuitively to improve
efficiencies. World-class driving dynamics,
including independent front and rear
suspensions with Frequency Selective
Damping (FSD) shocks, help to deliver
a smooth, controlled ride experienced
within a cabin that’s designed with the
tech-savvy in mind.
Limited in Black

SPECIFICATIONS

Wheelbase 101.2 Fuel Tank (gal) 12.7

Overall Height 66.5 2.4L 4x2 3,159
crossmember, high-strength steel double-shell lower control arms
2.4L 4x4 3,323
for 4x4 and high-strength steel mono-shell lower control arms for 4x2
4x2 / 4x4 / Trailhawk® 1.3L 4x4 Trailhawk 3,527
and stabilizer bar. Rear: Chapman struts, high-strength steel links,
Ground Clearance 6.7 / 8.0 / 8.7 Towing Capacity (when properly equipped; 4x4 models only) 2,000
